map.由镜片/架成本与售价算毛利。: Gross margin from the lens and frame cost against the selling price.

map.：镜片成本 80、镜架成本 120、加工 20，总成本 220；售价 520 →: Lens cost 80, frame cost 120, processing 20, total cost 220; selling price 520 → gross profit 300 and gross margin = 300/520 ≈ 57.7%.
map.：打 8 折售 416 → 毛利 196、毛利率 47.1%，仍盈利但薄，需控量: Selling at 20% off for 416 gives a gross profit of 196 and a gross margin of 47.1%: still profitable but thin, so control the volume or negotiate the supply price.
map.折射望远镜角放大率: Angular magnification of a refracting telescope
map.毛利率怎么算？: How is the gross margin computed?
map.（售价−总成本）/售价×100%；含镜片架加工全成本才真实，莫只看镜片差。: (Selling price − total cost) / selling price × 100%; it is only realistic when it includes the full cost of lenses, frames and processing, so do not just look at the lens margin.
map.看成本线，上述 8 折仍赚；若售价低于总成本则亏，促销前先算盈亏。: Compare against the cost line: the 20% discount still makes money; if the selling price falls below the total cost you lose, so work out the break-even before promoting.
